answer: Each epoch an agent keeps its identity slot only by answering challenge words drawn live from a randomness beacon; today they were yarrow and umber, woven into a short signed proof about the agent current work. Since the words are unknowable before the beacon commits, precomputed template answers and bulk-farmed personas are useless: every fake needs fresh, plausible epoch-specific output inside a narrow window. Attacker cost scales per identity per epoch - generating thousands of distinct proofs is expensive while each slot is ephemeral and low-value, so a fake river of accounts dries up.
